title: Rank-and-File Employee Stock Options and Workplace Safety
eligible_reason: Single adoption date. The only difference-in-differences analysis (Table 6, Panels C-E, and Figure 1) uses the passage of FAS 123R: treat_impact_lag is a time-invariant firm indicator (above-median pre-adoption pro forma R&F option expense) and post_n equals one for fiscal years 2008-2011 and zero for 2002-2004, so every treated firm switches on at the same date (one cohort). The headline specifications (Tables 2-5, 7, 8) regress injury rates on the continuous variable RF_portfolio_csho with establishment- and firm-level time-varying controls, and Table 6 Panel E is an IV (ivreg2h) estimate. Fails the at-least-two-adoption-dates rule; all DiD columns also carry time-varying controls.
design_notes: Establishment-year panel from OSHA (2002-2011) merged with Compustat/ExecuComp. Main regressions: reghdfe TCR RF_portfolio_csho <controls>, a(gvkey fyear) cluster(estab_group) (COOVZ_Replication Code.do). DiD block (lines 137-180): COOVZ_Firm Dataset for first stage (reghdfe RF_portfolio_csho treat_impact_lag_post_n, a(gvkey fyear)); COOVZ_DiD Dataset for Panel C column 1 (reghdfe TCR treat_impact_lag_post_n + 17 controls, a(gvkey fyear) cluster(estab_group)) and column 2 / Figure 1 (year-specific interactions treat_impact_lag_nn3 nn2 np1 np2 np3p, all relative to the single 2005-2007 adoption window). Panel D uses an alternative treatment ranking and adds executive-incentive controls; Panel E is ivreg2h with firm and year dummies.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: One cohort: FAS 123R adoption (post_n = 1 for 2008-2011, 0 for 2002-2004, 2005-2007 dropped) applies to all treated firms simultaneously.
modern_estimator_note: Full text cites Roth et al. (2023) per candidate flags, but no modern estimator appears in the code.

specs.exclusion_reason: single adoption date (FAS 123R); 17 time-varying establishment and firm controls
specs.treatment_definition: treat_impact_lag (firm above median pre-FAS 123R pro forma R&F option expense) x post_n (fiscal years 2008-2011)
specs.controls: estabsize hours_emp STRIKE_Q3 SHUT_Q3 SEASONAL_Q3 DISASTER_Q3 Top5_options_csho Ltotal_leverage Ltangibility Lturnover Lcapex Lsize_at Lag_cash_at Ldiv_at Lmtb Lsuspect2_2c

specs.treatment_definition: treated-firm indicator interacted with year dummies for 2002, 2003, 2008, 2009, 2010-2011 (2004 omitted)

data_access: partial (final establishment-level and firm-level analysis files shipped; raw OSHA/Compustat/ExecuComp inputs not provided)
priority_note: Not eligible: single-cohort DiD with controls; main analysis uses a continuous regressor.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Treatment timing confirmed from 'Data manual.docx' (post_n definition: 2008-2011 vs 2002-2004; event dummies defined by calendar year) and from the DiD block of COOVZ_Replication Code.do lines 137-180.
